svg.text: Fourteen landmark builds placed by world-layout v2 (sections 2, 4, 8), drawn in the same night style as the Birthday Castle elevation · heights in metres
pink, rose, plum and gold tie the world together; each style keeps its own material: Mughal marble, gothic violet glass, East-Asian white and red, desert sandstone, timber, snow
Mughal water palace on a stepped plinth in the Long Lake · 55 m
white marble, girih bands, warm jali arcades
gothic cathedral-castle on the east-bank cliff (40 m) · 90 m
lavender stone, slate spires, blue-violet rose window
stacked fairy-tale round towers on the Storybook crag · 80 m
rose walls, plum cones, gold flags, pink lancets
East-Asian tiered keep on a stone base, 5-tier pagoda · 70 m / 46 m
white plaster, red trim, dark curved roofs
pedimented octastyle temple and round tholos on the 110 m hill
rose-white marble, meander friezes, gold acroteria
Roman arena west of Temple Hill, arcade segment · 48 m
travertine, three arcade orders + attic, broken edge
Atlantis stepped blocks, Venetian campanile, Mughal teal dome
white blocks + gold statues, rose brick, teal dome
Moorish gold-domed palace; market under the 82 m rock arch
sandstone, horseshoe arches, gold domes, awnings
half-timbered houses, windmill tower house, tower bridge
timber + cream plaster, rose and plum tiles
pavilion on a 300 m sandstone pillar, rope bridge, glass dome
stepped tower ruin over waterfall terraces, east gorge · 40 m
mossy grey-green stone, gold glyph band
Nordic hall gable with carved scroll finials, rune monolith
dark timber, snow, cyan rune light beam
forest cottage, round window, lanterns, swooping roof · 12 m
stone, timber, mossy plum roof, glow mushrooms
140 m magenta tree on a rock island, hall beneath; 60 m tower
magenta canopy glow, timber hall, rock pedestal
heights above each building's own ground (crag, cliff, island or pillar foot); the castle (v3) is 418 m from its stair foot
All panels are front elevations at night, drawn in metres; each panel states its own scale. White bar = player 1.7 m.
No faces or animals: statues are veiled gold figures; the longhouse gables use carved scroll finials.
